name: Napkin Math
long_description:
Napkin Math is the personalized AI food journal that people love to use. We gamify nutrition tracking so people are 2x more likely to stick with us than other trackers. Claire, Manuel, and I (best friends for 10 years from MIT) are obsessed with how we can make nutrition fun, and turn fun into health outcomes.

===
Existing consumer health apps focus on scaling a one-size-fits-all solution: calorie deficits. But they don’t answer the questions you actually have.

Food is deeply personal, and so is Napkin Math:

Get the fuel you need for marathon training, while understanding you eat catered office lunches five days a week. Discover what’s triggering your stomach irritation, without sacrificing your weekly dinner with friends. Napkin Math tailors a plan for not only your specific health goal, but also your life.

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Napkin Math is the _hyper-personalized_ AI food journal that helps people achieve their health goals.

Join at <https://napkinmath.club> 🧺

<https://youtu.be/IJ09vrOkSOE>

### **THE PROBLEM & THE PRODUCT**

Existing consumer health apps focus on scaling a one-size-fits-all solution: calorie deficits. But they don’t answer the questions you actually have.

Food is deeply personal, and so is Napkin Math:

* Get the fuel you need for marathon training, while understanding you eat catered office lunches five days a week
* Discover what’s triggering your stomach irritation, without sacrificing your weekly dinner with friends.

Napkin Math tailors a plan for not only your specific health goal, but also your life.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102010&key=user_uploads/797433/1842f9f7-7918-4cc3-ab43-38de17ec30ba)

### THE KEY INSIGHTS

_Why hasn’t this been done before?_

1. **Before AI, personalization was impossible**. Tailoring a plan to every chronic condition, allergy, goal, and stage of life was impossible. With frontier models, we’re able to reimagine nutrition experiences from the ground up.
2. **We understand how to make taking a picture of your food fun.** How come Instagram foodies, who religiously follow “the camera eats first”, don’t also log their food in a journal? Napkin Math perfectly marries the joy of socially sharing food with a rich database that can help foodies feel better every day.

### THE TEAM

We’ve been friends for a decade since living together at MIT. 🧑‍🧑‍🧒

**Jynnie** worked on a games platform with 1MM players (Multiverse YC W20) and one of the largest Discord Games (Magic Circle, a16z Speedrun) — applying real gamification experience with AI to consumer health.

**Manuel** has cracked product across consumer, healthcare, and hardware, recently leading Verkada’s largest product line — bringing AI to real problems.

**Claire’s** work at Samsara through its IPO has given her insight into how tracking leads to safety outcomes for drivers, and now health outcomes for Napkin Math users.

Happy Tummy, Happy Life 😉 [Try Napkin Math](https://napkinmath.club)
